dedupe_keys.name: terrestrial and uav laser scanning point clouds of tum campus ottobrunn

description: Technical University of Munich and collaborating researchers publish terrestrial and UAV laser-scanning point clouds of the main Aerospace and Geodesy building at the TUM Campus Ottobrunn in Germany. Zenodo identifies version 1.0, published on 13 December 2024, as an open dataset under CC BY 4.0. The observations extend the TUM2TWIN project beyond the downtown Munich campus and provide geometry for a separate campus building. The repository description distinguishes TLS and ULS observations and points to documentation of acquisition, processing and supplementary material. The native TUM2TWIN page notes that work on enlarging the collection continues. Access is free through the Zenodo landing page. Detailed point-cloud formats, sampling resolution and acquisition dates were not independently established because the linked files and specification PDFs were not opened. These are caveats for combining the observations with other city geometry. The resource supports a building digital twin and is related to the existing aggregate TUM2TWIN benchmark. It remains distinct from the downtown UAV release.
